label: Synthetic recording
command: npm run dev, then PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=<playwright> node scripts/capture-cockpit-previews.mjs --out <dir>
data_boundary: Every task, member ID, note, count, and screen is invented fixture data. No engine, account, recording, run, or customer data is involved. The application screen inside Needs you and the sample is a generic synthetic page, not any vendor's product.

captures.shows: Synthetic task list: each task with one status and one next step.
Synthetic stop on the wrong record: the question, what was prevented, the screen, and the allowed choices.
Synthetic results: items done and checked, items that needed a person, a prevented wrong-record save, and a labeled time estimate.
Synthetic short readiness test: what it changes, the right-record check, the record check, practice run, drills, approval.
Synthetic list of member IDs and notes pasted into Run it, checked against the inputs the task needs.
Synthetic sample results: one run done and checked, and one where the app showed saved but the record check disagreed.
